authority: Current explicit operator instruction authorizes one bounded proof or fixed-observable disproof of full-cylinder fine-Gibbs L2 all-tail generator convergence. It changes no model, state, comparison map, time or earlier result.
question: For every fixed admissible parameter tuple, h,N,r0 and full invariant finite observable f0, do all tail-pair fine-Gibbs L2 generator defects tend to zero at the original local-state-cutoff-first stage?
test_domain: D_test^(h,N)=algebraic direct limit over r of the FULL A_(r,h,N)^inv under the approved I. Retain its inherited sup-norm algebra definition. This L2 defect is a separate diagnostic, not a new asserted limiting-generator domain or Hilbert isometry.
finite_domain: D(L_r)=C^(Omega_r). All signed PH/TR/LK/AP incidences, inverse duplicates, hidden labels, null rows and unmatched channels remain. L has no factor 1/2.
observable: Fix r0 and f0 with sup norm <=1 before all tail indices; f_r=I_(r0,r)f0. Homogeneous normalization covers every full finite complex invariant observable; no smoothness, energy or selected-observable restriction.
state: pi_s(x)=exp(-beta F_s(x))/sum_(all full counting tuples y)exp(-beta F_s(y)). No conditioning, comparison-pushforward replacement, rate fitting, counterterm or time rescaling.
target: For every fixed admissible parameter tuple,h,N,r0,f0 and eta>0, there exists R>=r0 such that for ALL integers s>r>=R, d2_(r,s)<eta. Equivalently lim_R sup_(s>r>=R)d2_(r,s)=0.
falsifier: One fixed admissible tuple,h,N,r0,f0 and eta0>0 such that for every R there exist s>r>=max(R,r0) with d2_(r,s)>=eta0. A single-state witness is insufficient without Gibbs-weight control; a single finite pair is insufficient without an arbitrary-tail construction.
ordered_scope: Vary local-state cutoff only: K_r=primorial(r+1), M_s=2^r, M_psi=m0*4^r, Rmax=R0*2^r, Q=q0*2^r. All parameters,h,N are fixed. Later h, then N, then inherited stages remain unexecuted and unchanged.
time: Original external stochastic Markov time and stationary initial-value boundary, no terminal conditioning.

separate_diagnostics.state_consistency: Measure discrepancy and existence of a representative-independent limiting pairing are separate questions; do not assume projectivity or a common L2 space.
separate_diagnostics.nontriviality: Track variance and original Dirichlet energy for any claimed surviving observable; zero-norm or zero-energy collapse is not nontrivial limiting dynamics. Constants and genuine kernel elements are not required to have positive energy.

bounded_attempt.analytic: One source-to-formula proof/counterexample pass, including aperture boundary and phase/link CRT channels; no carrier/parameter sweep.
bounded_attempt.independent: Separate direct formulation without importing the primary evaluator; disclose same-task authorship.
bounded_attempt.hostile: Test state weights, full labels, gauge/anchor invariance, all roots, sign/factor, fixed data and arbitrary tails, and distinguish state/nontriviality/physics.
bounded_attempt.Lean: Kernel-check a relevant exact algebra/inequality when feasible; explicitly retain all unencoded PAH source bridges.
bounded_attempt.exit: PROVED, DISPROVED or HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE. HOLD leaves exactly one missing bound/identity and a reentry condition. No repeated unchanged finite sweep.

literature_intake.internal: R-570 supplies finite operators and R-571 finite comparisons only. R-572 is an immutable sup-negative control and explicitly did not evaluate Gibbs L2.
